data.one_liner: An extended IndexedStack widget that supports lazy loading, preloading, and auto-disposal.
data.what_it_does: Extends IndexedStack to build child widgets only when needed instead of initializing all children simultaneously. It supports custom preloading of specific indexes and automatically disposing unused children.
use_when: You use bottom navigation bars with multiple tabs backed by an IndexedStack.
Your IndexedStack children perform heavy API requests or database access on initialization.
You need to optimize initial load times by deferring the creation of hidden views.
avoid_when: You need to preserve the exact UI state of every tab instantly without ever rebuilding them.
Your stack contains only a couple of very lightweight widgets.
strengths: Reduces initial build time by lazily loading child widgets.
Allows fine-grained control via preloading and auto-disposal parameters.
Drop-in replacement style usage similar to standard IndexedStack.
weaknesses: Auto-disposing children means their state will be lost when they are no longer visible unless managed externally.
data.minimal_example:
LazyLoadIndexedStack(
  index: _index,
  preloadIndexes: [1, 2],
  autoDisposeIndexes: [2, 3],
  children: [
    Page1(),
    Page2(),
    Page3(),
    Page4(),
  ],
)
